colors.name: Blush Paper
colors.role: Page canvas, section backgrounds, the warm field all content lives on

colors.name: Coral Crimson
colors.role: All headings, body text, icons, and the sole action color - the entire voice of the brand

colors.name: Midnight Ink
colors.role: Deep accent for select surfaces and inverse contexts, a cool counterpoint to the warm field

colors.name: Pure White
colors.role: Image backgrounds, inline accents, negative space within photographs and cards

colors.name: Soft Black
colors.role: Decorative strokes, icon fills, hairline borders - the only place pure black appears

fonts.name: Sansita
fonts.role: Display and heading face - bold, slightly condensed, with -0.02em tracking that tightens at every size. Carries all editorial weight: the page announces itself through this one confident voice.

fonts.name: Nunito Sans
fonts.role: Body and UI face - the 18px body sets a generous reading rhythm at 1.5 line-height; 700 weight for emphasized inline phrases and small caps headers. The 72px outlier is likely a single oversized numeral or pull-quote.

fonts.name: Clarkson
fonts.role: Secondary prose - the slightly taller 1.7 line-height is for long-form letter passages where breathing room matters more than density

components.name: Hero Statement
components.role: Opening page declaration - the largest text block on the site

components.name: Angled Image Bleed
components.role: Full-bleed photograph that breaks the pink field with a diagonal cut

components.name: Letter Section
components.role: Long-form prose block - the emotional heart of the page

components.name: Rounded Decorative Shape
components.role: 90px-radius geometric element used as visual punctuation

components.name: Side-by-Side Image Pair
components.role: Two-photo composition for showing complementary views

components.name: Section Anchor Header
components.role: Small-caps or oversized subhead marking a new prose section

do: Use only Coral Crimson (#db404f) for all text, icons, and interactive elements - never introduce a second chromatic text color
Set all body text at 18px with 1.5 line-height in Nunito Sans - smaller or denser prose breaks the editorial reading rhythm
Apply -0.02em letter-spacing to every Sansita heading size, scaling proportionally (e.g. -1.4px at 70px, -0.56px at 28px)
Break sections with full-bleed photographs using angled diagonal edges (8-12 clip-path), never with horizontal dividers or color bands
Use 90px border-radius for decorative shapes and 300px for the pill button - these two radii are the only geometry in the system
Maintain 144px top padding on major sections and 48px between paragraphs to preserve the slow, letter-like vertical cadence
Place all content directly on Blush Paper (#fce1e3) - no white cards, no elevated panels, no background containers
doNot: Do not add box-shadows, drop-shadows, or any z-depth indication - the design is intentionally paper-flat
Do not introduce additional accent colors - Coral Crimson is the only chromatic voice
Do not use rectangular image containers, standard card components, or 8-16px UI corner radii - the system operates at two radius extremes only
Do not set body text below 18px - the type scale starts at body and grows upward
Do not use horizontal rules, section dividers, or background color bands to separate content - use diagonal image bleeds and whitespace instead
Do not apply different colors to link states - all text including links stays Coral Crimson, distinguished only by underline
Do not use sans-serif for headlines - Sansita 700 is the only display voice and defines the editorial character
